description:
On the /credits page, 135 CMSA entries, 20 USAF entries, and 11 SpaceIL entries appear under the Wikimedia Commons and Solar System Scope sections instead of their intended sections. The routing in `provenanceSourceId()` → `agencyToSourceId()` has no clauses for agency values 'CMSA', 'USAF', or 'SpaceIL', and source-logos.json has no 'spaceil' section definition.

Expected: Every image-provenance entry is grouped under the section header matching its true producing organization, as declared by its `agency` field value. CMSA → CNSA section, USAF → U.S. Space Force section, SpaceIL → dedicated SpaceIL section (requires new source-logos entry).

Acceptance criteria:
- provenanceSourceId(makePhoto({ agency: 'CMSA', source_type: 'wikimedia-commons' })) returns 'cnsa' [reporter: Q: 'What source-logos id should CMSA entries route to?' A: 'Route to the existing 'cnsa' id — CMSA operates under CNSA.']
- provenanceSourceId(makePhoto({ agency: 'USAF', source_type: 'wikimedia-commons' })) returns 'us-space-force' [reporter: Q: 'Should USAF route to the existing 'us-space-force' source-logos section?' A: 'Route to the existing 'us-space-force' section — USAF folds into the US military space section.']
- provenanceSourceId(makePhoto({ agency: 'SpaceIL', source_type: 'wikimedia-commons' })) returns 'spaceil' [reporter: Q: 'What source-logos id should 'SpaceIL' entries route to?' A: 'It needs its own — the intended section id is 'spaceil'.']
- static/data/source-logos.json contains an entry with {id: 'spaceil', name: 'SpaceIL', license_summary: ...} (any valid logo_path and license data the maintainer supplies) [reporter: Q: 'What source-logos id should 'SpaceIL' entries route to?' A: 'It needs its own — the intended section id is 'spaceil'.' The section will not render without a source-logos entry — the /credits page creates groups from source-logos.json, so 'spaceil' must exist there.]
- Every image-provenance entry with agency value exactly 'CMSA' is routed to source section id 'cnsa' (135 entries) [repo-data: static/data/image-provenance.json — 135 entries have agency:'CMSA']
- Every image-provenance entry with agency value exactly 'USAF' is routed to source section id 'us-space-force' (20 entries) [repo-data: static/data/image-provenance.json — 20 entries have agency:'USAF']
- Every image-provenance entry with agency value exactly 'SpaceIL' is routed to source section id 'spaceil' (11 entries) [repo-data: static/data/image-provenance.json — 11 entries have agency:'SpaceIL']
- Entries with agency 'MBRSC (UAE Space Agency)' (5 entries), 'CFHT' (1 entry), 'EHT' (1 entry), and 'Multi-agency' (42 entries) continue to route to their current sections ('uaesa' and 'wikimedia-commons' respectively) — no regressions [reporter: Q (MBRSC): 'Stays under the existing 'uaesa' section.' Q (CFHT/EHT/Multi-agency): 'Stays under the Wikimedia Commons section.']

Domain facts:
- CMSA (China Manned Space Agency) is a sub-organization under the CNSA umbrella — its imagery belongs under the CNSA section.
- USAF space activities (X-37B missions) are distinct from U.S. Space Force but fold into the same /credits section per the maintainer's editorial decision.
- SpaceIL is a standalone Israeli non-profit — requires its own section with a distinct source-logos entry.
- The agency value in image-provenance.json is exactly 'CMSA' (not 'CNSA', not 'China Manned Space Agency', not 'CMSA / CNSA'). Lowercase: 'cmsa'. The existing check `a.includes('cnsa')` does NOT match 'cmsa'.
- The agency value for USAF entries is exactly 'USAF'. Lowercase: 'usaf'.
- The agency value for SpaceIL entries is exactly 'SpaceIL'. Lowercase: 'spaceil'.
